two_state_model.keys_profile_on: streak state (what the code branches on)

occupancy_model_L_calibrated.keys_profile_on: depth actually run (grants deep profile to every round)

decision_rule: Run M settles which conditioning is right. If raw >= 2.17 the occupancy model is vindicated and the streak gate should be deleted. If raw <= 2.05 the two-state model is right, the gate earns its keep purely by keeping post-reject rounds shallow, and gate 1 is the recommended setting.
